name: ultraresearch
description: Fast multi-source trend & research harness for Claude Code. Fan-out collects from Hacker News, Reddit, Bluesky, dev.to, GitHub, Lobsters, arXiv, and Naver (Korean blog/news) - plus X/Twitter via the agent. Cross-verifies across sources and can auto-synthesize a cited report (--format report). Bundles the insane-search block-resistant engine so social/community sources actually return content.
